kkutu.cmd_r: (/r) Click READY button. Click START button if leader.
kkutu.cmd_e: (/secret, /e user(to send chat to) the chat) user will receive a secret chats only visible between two.
kkutu.cmd_ee: (/s_recent, /ee the chat) send secret chat to the user that you most recently secrete-chatted with.
kkutu.cmd_wb: (/wb user(to block)) It will block all the secret chats from the user. If the command gets used when it was already used, it will undo the previous blocking command.
kkutu.cmd_shut: (/block user(to block)) It will block all the chats from the user. If the command gets used when it was already used, it will undo the previous blocking command.
kkutu.cmd_id: (/id user) It gives an ID of the user.(used when adding friends)
